name: AI Witch Video: You in the '60s Witchcore Reel
blurb: The AI witch video is a fully AI-made '60s witchcore skit: a witch in a tall black hat answers a cream rotary phone, says "No, sorry.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 12 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: a 1960s Technicolor-style witchcore mini film in a candle-lit red witch parlour, the same 8 shots, camera angles, cuts, timing, light and moves, in the same vertical frame. The ONLY change: the young woman with long copper-red hair is now the person in [Image 1]. [Image 1] is the sole reference for the witch's face and hair; [Video 1] is for the costume, the set, the moves, the mouth and the camera only.

The witch = the person in [Image 1], in EVERY shot, also in the face close-ups, the hand shots and the wide twirl: copy the exact face from [Image 1]: face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles exactly as in the photo. The same real person in every frame, so their friends recognize them at once. Never morph, never drift back to the original woman's face, eyes, nose or lips. NO long copper-red hair unless [Image 1] shows it; even when [Image 1] shows red hair, the face is only the face of [Image 1].

The costume is the joke and stays exactly as in [Video 1]: the tall black pointed witch hat, the long black dress with sheer black flowing sleeves (or a long black robe with the same sleeves) and bold turquoise winged eyeliner, never the clothes from [Image 1].

The shots, second by second:
1. 0-1.4 s: medium shot by a dark bookshelf with jars, old books, candles and brass wall lamps: the witch holds the handset of a cream rotary phone to the ear and says "No, sorry."
2. 1.4-2.5 s: close-up of the witch's face with the handset: "I have plans today."
3. 2.5-2.9 s: the medium shot again: "Bye."
4. 2.9-4.0 s: close-up of the cream rotary phone on the wooden desk: the witch's hand puts the handset down.
5. 4.0-6.1 s: medium shot, red velvet curtains and a tall window: the witch stirs a big black cauldron of white smoking potion with a long wooden spoon.
6. 6.1-7.3 s: close-up of the bubbling cauldron and the hand with the spoon.
7. 7.3-8.1 s: close-up of the witch's face, calm, eyes down, then up to the camera.
8. 8.1-11.7 s: wide shot of the red parlour: a big black cat floats down through the air beside the witch as if by magic while the witch twirls, the sheer sleeves flowing; the cat ends floating at the witch's side.

The mouth: the lips move exactly as the woman's lips do in [Video 1] on "No, sorry. I have plans today. Bye.", closed whenever hers are closed. Silent video: no voice audio and no background music.

Only replace the person; the parlour, the rotary phone, the cauldron, the black cat, the light and the camera stay completely unchanged. Keep everything else the same.

Anatomy rules: one head only, on the witch's shoulders. Two arms, five fingers on each hand. Exactly one person and one black cat. No text, no subtitles, no captions, no logos, no watermark.

prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot, as one continuous take: the same narrow, dark cobblestone alley at night between old stone walls, the same handheld camera that starts low on the boots, pulls back to the whole walker and rises to a close-up of the face, the same framing, timing and light. The ONLY change: replace the woman in the video with the person in [Image 1]. Strictly keep the way she moves and the camera moves. Only replace the person; the walk, the motion path and the alley stay unchanged. Keep everything else the same. [Image 1] is the sole reference for the walker's face and hair; [Video 1] is for the costume, the alley, the walk and the camera only.

The walker = the person in [Image 1], in EVERY frame: copy the exact face from [Image 1]: face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles exactly as in the photo. Keep the original identity, face structure, skin tone, hairstyle and body shape of [Image 1]. The same real person in every frame, so their friends instantly recognize them, above all in the final close-up. Never morph, never drift back to the original woman's face. NO long straight black hair unless [Image 1] shows it. NO silver cross earrings and NO earrings unless [Image 1] shows them.

COSTUME: always the costume from [Video 1], never the clothes from [Image 1]: a wide-brimmed pointed black witch hat, an opaque black lace top with a solid black lining, off the shoulders, with long lace sleeves, a tiered black velvet ruffle mini skirt with a long lace train behind, and black knee-high lace-up boots. The top is never see-through: the lining covers the whole chest in every frame. Bold black winged eyeliner. A man wears the same hat and boots, a lined black lace shirt, a long black coat and black trousers.

THE WALK, beat by beat, one continuous shot with no cuts:
00:00-00:02.5: the camera is low, at knee height: only the boots, the legs and the skirt hem, stepping toward the lens on the cobblestones.
00:02.5-00:03.5: the camera pulls back: the whole walker, hat to boots, the lace train flowing behind.
00:03.5-00:07: the walker walks straight toward the camera down the alley, calm and confident, eyes on the lens.
00:07-00:09: the walker comes close and the camera rises from the waist to the face.
00:09-00:10: close-up of the face under the hat brim: the walker stops and gives a slow, cool look into the camera.

Real live-action footage, clear facial features. The lips stay closed. No dialogue throughout the entire video. No background music.

One head only, on the walker's shoulders. Two arms, two legs, five fingers on each hand. Exactly one person.

No cuts, no see-through clothes, no bare chest, no text, no captions, no logos, no watermarks, no extra people, no morphing, no facial distortion.

prompts.text: Use the uploaded image as the base: the same person, now in a candle-lit witch ritual in a forest at night. The person kneels upright on a large black cloth in the middle of a circle of about twenty lit white pillar candles of different heights, with a few tarot cards laid face up on the cloth and a few red roses between the candles. The person holds one thin, lit, pale blue taper candle in both hands at chest height and looks straight into the camera with a calm, knowing, slightly mysterious look. Outfit: a tall black pointed witch hat with a wide brim and a long black lace dress with long sheer lace sleeves that covers the knees. A man wears the same hat and a long black robe with the same sheer lace sleeves. The kneeling person from the knees up in the middle of the frame, the nearest candles along the bottom edge, the face clear, sharp and lit warm by the candle flames, turned to the camera. Photorealistic, natural skin, real candle light and deep natural shadows: no cinematic color grading, no soft dreamy glow, no blurred bokeh, not CGI, not a cartoon. The tarot cards show plain old-style art with no readable text. Vertical 9:16. Exactly one person, no one else in the forest. No signs, no text, no logos, no watermarks.

The friend on the left holds one lit white pillar candle on a small dish between them at chest height; the friend on the right holds a small stack of tarot cards. Both look into the camera with a calm, playful, knowing smile. Outfits: the friend on the left wears a long deep-red ruffled dress with long sleeves, the friend on the right a long black lace dress with long sheer lace sleeves, and both wear tall black pointed witch hats; a man wears a dark shirt and a long black coat in place of the dress.
